config.curve_metric: unconstrained DTW with sum of Euclidean point costs
config.multicurve_metric: minimum over curve bijections of maximum pairwise DTW
config.claim_scope: empirical validation only; no transfer of Frechet collision or approximation guarantees
config.blocking_selection: minimum tuning M/100MB + median_T/1ms among DTW tuning-qualified configurations
config.baseline_selection: fastest DTW tuning-qualified configuration under the same index budget

manifest.metric: unconstrained DTW with sum of Euclidean point costs

aggregation.quality: arithmetic mean of three seed statistics
aggregation.ratio_tails: mean of conditional per-seed tail statistics; not pooled quantiles
aggregation.missing: no aggregate unless all three seeds are available

definitions.recall: returned DTW cost <= exact DTW optimum + 1e-8
definitions.success_at_1_1: returned DTW cost <= 1.1 * exact DTW optimum + 1e-8
definitions.ratios: conditional on a nonempty return; zero/zero=1; positive/zero=infinity
definitions.index_MB: allocated serving index bytes / 1000000; excludes raw curves and scratch
definitions.dtw_frechet_consistency: exact DTW optimum >= paired exact Frechet optimum - 1e-8; consistency only
definitions.frechet_reference_nonoptimal: reference parent DTW cost > exact DTW optimum + 1e-8

notes: Empirical DTW measurements only; no model-estimated timings or memory.
No Frechet collision or approximation guarantees are transferred.
DTW/Frechet optimum ordering is checked for artifact consistency only.
Exact truth is checked against the checksum-validated cache, not recomputed by this publisher.
Synthetic database identity is checked via frozen control hashes; NBA arrays are also hashed.
Unavailable methods retain per-seed tuning exclusions; resource estimates are not measurements.
